funding_source: Unrestricted Supplemental

outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

summary: The board is ratifying (approving after the fact) a contract with an Oakland consultant, for up to $57,500, for the 2020-2021 school year at Franklin Elementary School. The contractor will run daily support groups and one-on-one help for "at promise" students, contact their parents by phone or home visits, train Franklin staff, and hold parent workshops in families' primary languages. The service period began August 1, 2020, before the board's August 26 meeting.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 - Elizabeth Gomez - Rudsdale Newcomer High School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 between the District and  Elizabeth Gomez, San Leandro, CA, for the latter to provide advocacy for students as they deal with the health care system as well as create a training for students to become Health Advocates themselves; teach a Health Advocacy elective course on Wednesdays; participate in COST team focused on supporting students dealing with MediCal and appointments, at Rudsdale Newcomer High School, for the period of August 3, 2020 through June 30, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $35,000.00.
funding_source: Measure N
headline: Ratifies up to $35,000 for a health advocacy contractor at Rudsdale Newcomer High
summary: The board is ratifying (approving after the fact) a contract with a San Leandro contractor, for up to $35,000, at Rudsdale Newcomer High School. The contractor will help students navigate the health care system, create a training for students to become health advocates, teach a Health Advocacy elective on Wednesdays, and join the school team that supports students with MediCal and appointments. The service period starts August 3, 2020, before the board's August 26 meeting; the end date as printed is June 30, 2020, which appears to be a typo.
